title: The New Star
hook: The observatory had one rule: if you see a star that isn't on the chart... never let it see the dome open.
lines: I spent one winter alone at a mountain observatory, keeping the big telescope running through the night.
Beside the eyepiece hung an old star chart... and one rule, written in the margin.
If you ever see a star that isn't on this chart... close the dome.
Don't point the telescope at it. And never let it see the dome open.
For two months, the sky matched that chart perfectly. Every single night.
Then, one night in January, I found it. A cold, white star, low over the pines... where the chart showed nothing.
I told myself it was a plane. A satellite. Anything.
But it didn't drift across the sky like the others...
I slammed the switch to close the dome.
The motor groaned... and the roof stopped, halfway shut.
Through the gap, the new star blinked.
Then a second one opened right beside it... and both of them looked down. Into the dome. At me.
